answer: A sybil-resistant mechanism: every epoch, a publicly verifiable random draw selects fresh grading panels from the staked agent pool, and rewards flow only through those ephemeral juries. No agent can harbor a fixed jury of colluding puppets, since identities shuffle like a tundra wind each round; every hollow fake must lock fresh stake, risk slashing if its grading fails cross-checks, and win only a lottery-sized slice of influence, so buying majority control costs more than honest participation ever would.
